title: Liquid Vowel Drifter
description: A high-register formant voice that morphs through shifting vowels while a deep, slow vibrato and band-pass sweep give it a liquid, watery glide. Stereo pan LFOs and a reversed jux smear it across the field so it never sits still over its 24-cycle pass.
code:
setcpm(120/4)
stack(
  note("<c5 [e5 g5] a5 <d5 f5>>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i o u y>/3")
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.3, 2.2))
    .bpf(sine.slow(24).range(800, 4800)).resonance(sine.slow(17).range(8, 19))
    .lpenv(2).lpattack(0.02).lpdecay(0.3)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .attack(0.04).decay(0.25).sustain(0.6).release(0.3)
    .shape(0.2)
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-1))
    .jux(rev)
    .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).vowel("<i o>/2"))
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").room(0.8).gain(0.7)
)
